description:
Music video directed by Makoto Bessho for the song THE POLiCY by IDOLiSH7. The full music video prominently features scenes not seen in the anime's opening sequence. This is the 16th music video created for the IDOLiSH7 franchise.

Note: This song, and parts of this music video, serves as the opening of IDOLiSH7: Third BEAT!
